title: MarineTraffic Anchorage Dwell Ranking
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marinetraffic:vessel
| stats avg(anchor_hours) as avg_anchor_hours, max(anchor_hours) as max_anchor_hours by vessel_name
| where avg_anchor_hours>12
| sort - avg_anchor_hours
description: Uses MarineTraffic anchorage history telemetry to monitor how long favorite vessels are sitting at anchor in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for ships or routes held up longer than expected, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MarineTraffic anchorage history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vessel ranking by anchorage dwell time.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how long favorite vessels are sitting at anchor so you can spot ships or routes held up longer than expected before it becomes annoying.
